 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

1. Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 23.02.2021 passed in MVC No.238/2019 by the Court of the I Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT-V at Davanagere (for short 'the Tribunal'),
the petitioner therein has preferred this appeal.

entities.text: I Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT-V at Davanagere
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

Brief facts of the case are as follows:
On 07.02.2018 the petitioner along with few others was traveling in a Ertiga Car bearing Reg.No.KA-17/P- 5897.
At about 11.00 p.m. the Car met with an accident near D.C. Office, Davanagere, when the Car dashed against the divider and the petitioner sustained injuries.
He preferred MVC No.238/2019 and the Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with interest at 9% p.a. from the date of petition till realization.

The Car was duly insured with respondent No.3-Insurance Company at Rudresh vs Nanjundappa P B @ Nanjundaswamy on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172574550/
2 the time of accident.
The present appeal is filed by the petitioner for enhancement of compensation.
4. There is no dispute as to the liability of the Insurance Company.

5. After arguing the matter for some time, the advocates for the petitioner and respondent no.3-Insurance Company jointly submit that the compensation amount may be enhanced globally by another Rs.50,000/- without interest.

The appeal is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.3-Insurance Company to pay an additional sum of Rs.50,000/- to the petitioner without any interest within six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
